places.name: ION Orchard
places.ai_summary: A luxury shopping mall featuring high-end brands, fine dining, and an observation deck with panoramic views of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Observation deck hours may vary.

places.place_tip: Visit the observation deck for a unique view of Orchard Road.

places.name: Paragon Shopping Centre
places.ai_summary: A premium shopping destination offering designer boutiques, gourmet dining, and a family-friendly atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Special events may extend hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the gourmet dining options on the top floor.

places.name: Ngee Ann City (Takashimaya)
places.ai_summary: A major shopping and lifestyle destination with a wide range of retail stores, restaurants, and a popular Japanese department store.

opening_hours.notes: Department store hours may vary.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the food court in the basement for a variety of local delights.

places.name: Plaza Singapura
places.ai_summary: A shopping mall with a mix of retail, dining, and entertainment options, popular with both locals and tourists.

opening_hours.notes: Check for individual store hours.

places.place_tip: Catch a movie at the Golden Village cinema located in the mall.

places.name: The Centrepoint
places.ai_summary: A shopping mall offering a variety of retail stores, dining options, and a supermarket, catering to everyday needs.

opening_hours.notes: Supermarket hours may vary.

places.place_tip: Great place to pick up groceries and local snacks.

places.name: Orchard Central
places.ai_summary: A shopping mall with a wide range of retail outlets, dining options, and an indoor rock climbing gym.

opening_hours.notes: Rock climbing gym hours may vary.

places.place_tip: Try the indoor rock climbing for a unique experience.

places.name: Tangs Department Store
places.ai_summary: A famous department store offering a wide range of products including clothing, cosmetics, and home goods, with a focus on Asian brands.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special promotions and events.

places.place_tip: Explore the basement level for unique Asian snacks and gifts.

places.name: Design Orchard
places.ai_summary: A creative space and retail concept showcasing Singaporean and Asian designers, offering a range of fashion, accessories, and lifestyle products.

opening_hours.notes: Check for designer showcase events.

places.place_tip: Look out for exclusive designer collaborations and pop-up stores.

places.name: Mandarin Gallery
places.ai_summary: A stylish shopping mall with a mix of luxury brands, contemporary fashion, and fine dining options.

opening_hours.notes: Dining options may have different hours.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a meal at one of the fine dining restaurants after shopping.

places.name: Far East Plaza
places.ai_summary: A popular shopping mall known for its affordable fashion, accessories, and a wide variety of food options.

opening_hours.notes: Food court hours may vary.

places.place_tip: Bargain hunting is highly recommended for great deals.

places.name: Scotts Square
places.ai_summary: A luxury retail mall with a curated selection of high-end brands, fine dining, and an art gallery.

opening_hours.notes: Art gallery hours may vary.

places.place_tip: Visit the art gallery for a dose of culture amidst shopping.

places.name: Wheelock Place
places.ai_summary: A shopping mall with a good mix of retail, dining, and entertainment options, including a cinema and arcade.

opening_hours.notes: Cinema and arcade hours may vary.

places.place_tip: Check out the latest movies at the cinema.

places.name: 313@Somerset
places.ai_summary: A vibrant shopping mall with a wide range of fashion, lifestyle stores, and a variety of dining options.

opening_hours.notes: Dining options may have different hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the rooftop for a unique dining experience with a view.

places.name: Emerald Hill Bars & Shophouses
places.ai_summary: A historic street known for its well-preserved shophouses and vibrant nightlife, with a range of bars and restaurants.

opening_hours.notes: Bar hours may vary, and some may require reservations.

places.place_tip: Experience the vibrant nightlife and try the local cocktails.

places.name: Orchard Gateway Bridge
places.ai_summary: A pedestrian bridge connecting Orchard Gateway to the Orchard MRT station, offering a unique architectural design and a scenic walk.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for the sunset view.

places.place_tip: Don't forget your camera for some stunning photos.

attribution.author: Jacklee.
attribution.description: The Tube, a skyway on Level 3 of Orchard Gateway that links to Orchard Gateway@Emerald on the other side of Orchard Road, Singapore.

places.name: Cathay Cineleisure
places.ai_summary: A popular cinema complex offering the latest movies, comfortable seating, and a range of dining options.

opening_hours.notes: Check movie timings and book tickets in advance.

places.place_tip: Try the local snacks at the cinema for a unique treat.

attribution.title: Cineleisure Orchard, Dec 05
attribution.author: User:Sengkang
attribution.description: Cineleisure Orchard with reflection of Orchard Building.

places.name: Orchard Road Christmas Light-Up (Seasonal)
places.ai_summary: An annual festive event featuring stunning light displays along Orchard Road, attracting visitors from all over.

opening_hours.notes: Event dates and times may vary each year.

places.place_tip: Visit on a weekday to avoid large crowds.

places.name: Goodwood Park Hotel High Tea
places.ai_summary: A luxurious high tea experience at the iconic Goodwood Park Hotel, featuring a selection of fine teas, pastries, and local delights.

opening_hours.notes: Reservation recommended, especially on weekends.

places.place_tip: Try the local pastries for a unique twist on traditional high tea.

places.name: Mount Elizabeth Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A scenic viewpoint located on Mount Elizabeth, offering panoramic views of the Orchard Road skyline and beyond.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the stunning views.

attribution.author: Donald McKague
attribution.description: Official portrait of Queen Elizabeth II before the start of her 1959 tour, wearing the Vladimir Tiara, the Queen Victoria Jubilee Necklace, the blue Garter Riband, Badge and Garter Star and the Royal Family Orders of King George V and King George VI

places.name: Orchard MRT Underground Mall
places.ai_summary: An underground shopping mall connected to Orchard MRT station, featuring a variety of retail stores and dining options.

opening_hours.notes: Access via Orchard MRT station.

places.place_tip: Great for shopping and dining without having to deal with the weather.
